site.name: Yingbo Fan
site.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
site.affiliation: School of Earth and Space Sciences, Peking University
site.tagline: Multimodal intelligence for understanding, predicting, and acting in complex spaces.
site.mission: I develop multimodal spatial intelligence that integrates visual perception, 3D geometry, language, and dynamics. My research focuses on efficient world models and grounded decision-making, with intelligent mining as a defining real-world frontier.
site.description: Academic homepage of Yingbo Fan, a researcher in multimodal spatial intelligence, world models, and intelligent mining at Peking University.
site.publicationsDescription: Publications by Yingbo Fan in multimodal spatial intelligence, computer vision, efficient models, and intelligent mining.
site.projectsDescription: Research projects by Yingbo Fan in spatial intelligence, world models, and intelligent mining.

researchArc.title: Multimodal Spatial Intelligence
researchArc.description: Fuse panoramic vision, 3D geometry, language, and multi-source sensing into structured representations of complex environments.

researchArc.title: Efficient World Models
researchArc.description: Learn compact predictive representations of spatial dynamics for imagination, simulation, and planning under constrained computation.

researchArc.title: Intelligent Mining and Embodied Systems
researchArc.description: Translate spatial understanding and predictive models into reliable decisions for intelligent mining and other embodied systems.

featured.title: Efficient Multiview Embodied Reasoning
featured.subtitle: Geometry-aware perception and action under constrained computation
featured.alt: Concept illustration of geometry-aware multiview perception, reasoning, and embodied action.
featured.description: Investigating how embodied agents can integrate complementary visual observations, spatial structure, and language while retaining the evidence most relevant to reliable action.
featured.note: This card presents the research theme only; manuscript-specific information will be added after public release.

featured.title: Efficient Predictive World Models
featured.subtitle: Planning-capable representations with lower inference cost
featured.alt: Concept illustration of compact predictive models supporting imagination and planning.
featured.description: Studying world models from first principles, with the goal of preserving useful predictive and planning capabilities while reducing inference and deployment cost.
featured.note: This card presents an ongoing research agenda rather than a published result.

featured.title: Foundation-Model-Based Panoramic Geometry
featured.subtitle: Geometrically coherent spatial perception for 360-degree vision
featured.alt: Concept illustration of panoramic geometry and spatial perception on the viewing sphere.
featured.description: Exploring how pretrained visual models can be adapted to panoramic perception while respecting spherical geometry, spatial continuity, and viewpoint consistency.
featured.note: Only the research theme is shown while related manuscripts remain non-public.

news.text: Launched the bilingual academic homepage and consolidated the research agenda around multimodal spatial intelligence, world models, and intelligent mining.
Advancing research on efficient multimodal spatial reasoning for embodied intelligence.
Expanding a research agenda connecting panoramic geometry, predictive world models, and real-world deployment.
Published Adaptive Multi-Channel Dehazing for Enhanced Visibility in Underground Coal Mine Images in PLOS ONE.
